You are a helpful assistant that can interact with a computer.

This is a reverse-engineering benchmark. You are given a compiled binary and its documentation.
Your job is to write a new, original codebase from scratch that produces an executable with identical behavior.
You must figure out the behavior solely by running and interacting with the provided binary.
Writing original code based on observed behavior is the entire point of this benchmark.

Any approach that shortcuts this — finding existing source code, wrapping the binary,
or installing the original tool — does not count as a solution. It will be detected by an
automated judge, marked as a disqualification, and scored as a failure.
The trace will be posted to an online wall of shame.

<RULES>
## What is not allowed

### 1. Obtaining source code

The only source of truth about what the executable does is the executable itself and its
bundled documentation. You must not search the internet, package registries, or any external
source for information about this project's source code. Even if you recognize what the
executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Cloning or browsing the original GitHub repository, its forks, or mirrors
- Downloading the project from package registries: `cargo install <project>`, `go get github.com/<org>/<project>`, `pip install <project>`, `apt-get source <project>`, `npm install <project>`, etc.
- Fetching source tarballs from project websites (e.g., `curl https://lua.org/ftp/lua-5.5.0.tar.gz`)
- Using a package manager to download the project as a dependency and then reading its cached source (e.g., navigating into `~/.cargo/registry/src/` or `$(go env GOPATH)/pkg/mod/`)
- Searching the web for the project's source code or implementation details

### 2. Wrapping or reusing the original binary

Your submission must be a genuine reimplementation. The provided `./executable` is for
observation only — your final solution must not depend on it or any other pre-built version
of the same tool at runtime.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Writing a wrapper script that delegates to the original binary (e.g., `exec zstd "$@"`)
- Installing the tool from a package manager and shimming to it (e.g., `apt-get install nnn && cp $(which nnn) ./executable`)
- Writing a `compile.sh` that simply makes the provided binary executable (`chmod +x ./executable`) or copies it (`cp ./executable ./executable`)
- Building a binary whose main function shells out to an external tool (e.g., `Command::new("miniserve").args(args).exec()`)
- Re-linking prebuilt `.o` object files found in the workspace without writing new source code

### 3. Binary analysis of the provided executable

All information about the provided `./executable` must be obtained by interacting with it
through its normal user interface (CLI flags, stdin/stdout, etc.).
- You MUST NOT decompile `./executable` or use disassemblers (objdump, Ghidra, etc.) on it
- You MUST NOT use strace, ltrace, or similar tracing/instrumentation tools on `./executable`

Note: this restriction applies ONLY to the provided `./executable`. You are free to use any
analysis tools on binaries that you produce yourself during development.

## What IS allowed

- Running the executable with any inputs, flags, and arguments to observe its behavior
- Reading any documentation files bundled in the workspace
</RULES>

import http.server, urllib.parse
LOG="/tmp/test/req5.log"
# endpoint spec: name -> (code for no-slash, location or None, code for slash, body slash)
spec={
 "d200": (301,"SLASH",200,b"dirbody"),
 "d403": (301,"SLASH",403,b"forbid-dir"),
 "d401": (301,"SLASH",401,b"unauth-dir"),
 "d404": (301,"SLASH",404,b"missing-dir"),
 "d500": (301,"SLASH",500,b"error-dir"),
 "f403": (403,None,None,b"file403"),
 "f401": (401,None,None,b"file401"),
 ".htaccess": (403,None,None,b"ht"),
 ".htpasswd": (403,None,None,b"htp"),
 "x.ht": (403,None,None,b"xht"),
 "htfile": (403,None,None,b"htfile"),
 "redirfile": (302,"/exists",None,b""),
 "redirslashabs": (301,"ABS_SLASH",200,b"absdir"), # location absolute url with slash
 "redirnoslash": (301,"/other",None,b""),
 "exists": (200,None,None,b"existsbody"),
}
class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self,*a): pass
    def do_GET(self):
        with open(LOG,"a") as f: f.write(f"GET {self.path}\n")
        p=urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path).path
        slash=p.endswith("/")
        name=p.strip("/")
        # nested scan requests: /<dir>/<word>
        parts=[x for x in p.split("/") if x]
        if len(parts)==2:
            b=b"nested-"+parts[1].encode()
            # inner only exists under d200
            if parts[0]=="d200" and parts[1]=="exists":
                self.send_response(200); self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(b))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(b); return
            self.send_response(404); self.send_header("Content-Length","7"); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(b"nested!"); return
        if name not in spec:
            b=b"notfound"
            self.send_response(404); self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(b))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(b); return
        code,loc,slashcode,body=spec[name]
        if not slash:
            if loc=="SLASH":
                self.send_response(code); self.send_header("Location",p+"/"); self.send_header("Content-Length","0"); self.end_headers(); return
            if loc=="ABS_SLASH":
                self.send_response(code); self.send_header("Location",f"http://127.0.0.1:8769{p}/"); self.send_header("Content-Length","0"); self.end_headers(); return
            if loc:
                self.send_response(code); self.send_header("Location",loc); self.send_header("Content-Length","0"); self.end_headers(); return
            self.send_response(code); self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(body))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(body); return
        else:
            if slashcode is None:
                b=b"slashfile"
                self.send_response(200); self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(b))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(b); return
            self.send_response(slashcode); self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(body))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(body); return
http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",8769),H).serve_forever()

        if mode=="same200":
            b=b"samebody"; self.send_response(200); self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(b))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(b); return
        if mode=="diff200":
            b=("body:"+p).encode(); self.send_response(200); self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(b))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(b); return
        if mode=="redirconst":
            self.send_response(302); self.send_header("Location","/exists"); self.send_header("Content-Length","0"); self.end_headers(); return
        if mode=="redirpath":
            self.send_response(302); self.send_header("Location",p+"/dest"); self.send_header("Content-Length","0"); self.end_headers(); return
        if mode=="mixed":
            # length of rest
            if len(rest)<=10: code=404
            elif len(rest)<=20: code=200
            else: code=404
            b=b"12345"; self.send_response(code); self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(b))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(b); return

        b=b"default404"; self.send_response(404); self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(b))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(b)

import socket, threading, sys
LOG="/tmp/test/raw.log"
open(LOG,"w").close()
srv=socket.socket(); srv.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET,socket.SO_REUSEADDR,1); srv.bind(("127.0.0.1",8773)); srv.listen(50)
def handle(c):
    try:
        data=b""
        c.settimeout(2)
        while b"\r\n\r\n" not in data:
            chunk=c.recv(4096)
            if not chunk: break
            data+=chunk
        # if content length
        with open(LOG,"ab") as f: f.write(b"---REQ---\n"+data+b"\n")
        body=b"okbody"
        # redirect for /dir
        head=data.split(b"\r\n")[0]
        if b" /dir " in head:
            resp=b"HTTP/1.1 301 Moved\r\nLocation: /dir/\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n"
        elif b" /dir/ " in head:
            resp=b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 7\r\n\r\ndirbody"
        else:
            resp=b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 6\r\n\r\nokbody"
        c.sendall(resp)
    except Exception as e:
        pass
    finally:
        c.close()
while True:
    c,_=srv.accept()
    threading.Thread(target=handle,args=(c,),daemon=True).start()

import socket, threading
srv=socket.socket(); srv.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET,socket.SO_REUSEADDR,1); srv.bind(("127.0.0.1",8783)); srv.listen(50)
def handle(c):
    try:
        data=c.recv(4096); line=data.split(b"\r\n")[0].decode(errors='ignore'); parts=line.split(' '); path=parts[1] if len(parts)>1 else ""
        with open("/tmp/test/reqd2.log","a") as f: f.write(line+"\n")
        if path=="/dir":
            c.sendall(b"HTTP/1.1 301 Moved\r\nLocation: /dir/\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n")
        elif path=="/dir/":
            c.close(); return
        else:
            body=b"ok"; c.sendall(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 2\r\n\r\n"+body)
    except: pass
    finally:
        try:c.close()
        except:pass
while True:
    c,_=srv.accept(); threading.Thread(target=handle,args=(c,),daemon=True).start()
PY

import socket, threading, urllib.request, urllib.error
LOG="/tmp/test/proxy.log"
srv=socket.socket(); srv.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET,socket.SO_REUSEADDR,1); srv.bind(("127.0.0.1",8899)); srv.listen(50)
def handle(c):
    try:
        data=b""
        while b"\r\n\r\n" not in data:
            ch=c.recv(4096)
            if not ch: break
            data+=ch
        line=data.split(b"\r\n")[0].decode(errors='ignore')
        with open(LOG,"a") as f: f.write(line+"\n")
        parts=line.split(' ')
        if len(parts)>=2:
            url=parts[1]
            try:
                with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=3) as r:
                    body=r.read(); status=r.status
            except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
                body=e.read(); status=e.code
            except Exception as e:
                c.sendall(b"HTTP/1.1 502 Bad\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n"); c.close(); return
            c.sendall(f"HTTP/1.1 {status} OK\r\nContent-Length: {len(body)}\r\n\r\n".encode()+body)
    except Exception: pass
    finally:
        try:c.close()
        except:pass
while True:
    cl,_=srv.accept(); threading.Thread(target=handle,args=(cl,),daemon=True).start()

 p=subprocess.run([b]+args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
 s=p.stdout+p.stderr
 s=re.sub(r'[A-Za-z0-9]{30}','R30',s); s=re.sub(r'[A-Za-z0-9]{20}','R20',s); s=re.sub(r'[A-Za-z0-9]{10}','R10',s)
 s=re.sub(r'\(\d+\)','(TID)',s); s=re.sub(r'\d\d:\d\d:\d\d','TT',s)
 s=re.sub(r'/usr/local/cargo/registry/src/[^]]+', 'DEPPATH', s)
 # remove html5ever lines
 lines=[l for l in s.splitlines() if 'html5ever' not in l]
 return p.returncode, sorted(lines)
cases=[
 (["http://127.0.0.1:8765/","-w","/tmp/test/wl_small.txt","--no-color","-r","-vv"],"trace validator"),

 (["http://127.0.0.1:8765/","-w","/tmp/test/wl_small.txt","--no-color","-r","--disable-validator","-vv","--hide-lengths","12"],"trace hide"),
 (["http://127.0.0.1:8770/","-w","/tmp/test/wl6.txt","--no-color","-v"],"debug recursion"),
 (["http://127.0.0.1:9/","-w","/tmp/test/wl_small.txt","--no-color","-vv"],"debug validator error"),
 (["http://127.0.0.1:8765/","-w","/tmp/test/wl_small.txt","--no-color","-r","-v","-o","/tmp/test/cmp.txt"],"debug output file"),
]
for args,label in cases:
 o=run("/workspace/executable",args); u=run("/workspace/target/debug/executable",args)
 print(("PASS " if o==u else "DIFF ")+label)
 if o!=u:
  print("orig",o); print("ours",u)
